scope.item: Architectural services for preparation of Architectural 2D plan, section and elevation along with obtaining NOC for proposed tourism projects in PPP mode

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening. EMD exemption (including NSIC/MSME) expressly not allowed.

period.bid_validity: 120 days from date of opening of financial bid

eligibility: Architectural firms/individual architects registered with the Council of Architecture; firm profile, photographs and certificates to be submitted

Experience of architectural consultancy for Central/State Govt/PSU tourism projects or multi-storied buildings in last 7 financial years: three similar works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%

Similar works: architectural drawings for visitor infrastructure (eco-friendly cottages, play areas, light & sound shows, kiosks, cafes, landscaping, open air theatre, parking, toilet blocks etc.) or multistoried buildings in India, with NOC from local authority
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); non-blacklisting affidavit
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost; list of relatives in Ministry of Shipping/DGLL; activity chart; self-assessing technical evaluation sheet
